claim: Form 2367 is the Individual Overseas Housing Allowance (OHA) Report
Purpose text quoted from the form's Privacy Act statement
quote: TO DETERMINE IF YOU ARE A "SHARER" FOR HOUSING ALLOWANCE PURPOSES, SELECT THE APPROPRIATE BOX FOR EACH CATEGORY
fix: Attribute the quote to block 11, the sharer question. The Privacy Act statement sits on page 2 and states the purpose as determining eligibility for OHA.

claim: Member completes parts A and B and signs and dates block 10
fix: Block 10 is utilities. The member signs block 13 on the JAN 2024 edition. Update the block numbers and note PRIUM 8-0207 still cites the older edition.

claim: Housing officer or appropriate official completes and signs block 11
fix: Block 11 is the sharer question. The housing officer signs block 14 on the JAN 2024 edition.

claim: Commanding officer or designated representative approves in block 12
quote: 15. CERTIFYING OFFICIAL. I HAVE REVIEWED THIS ACTION AND CERTIFY THE ENTITLEMENT.
fix: Block 12 reports sharer names. The certifying official signs block 15 on the JAN 2024 edition.

claim: Unit files the original in correspondence files, retains only the most current form, returns the duplicate to the Marine
quote: After approval file the original approved report in the unit's correspondence files per SECNAV M-5210.1.

claim: Anytime information changes, the member completes a new report
quote: Anytime information contained on the current report changes, a new report must be completed.

claim: MCAAT checks OHA and FSH DD 2367 filed in OMPF within 10 working days of diary date or effective date, FSH reported within 5 days
quote: Is the Overseas Housing Allowance (OHA) (DD Form 2367) filed in OMPF within 10 working days from the date reported on unit diary?

claim: MARADMIN 115/24 backs the FSH reporting item
quote: report transaction type code (TTC) 388/002 Family Separation Housing-B (FSH-B)
fix: MARADMIN 115/24 sets the FSH-B start TTC for PME PCS. It sets no 5-day reporting rule. Cite MCTFSPRIUM 9-90301 for the 5-day item.

claim: MARADMIN 015/20 lists the form among required pay substantiation documents (candidate cancelled by PAA 03-20)
quote: 4.b.2. Overseas Housing Allowance (OHA). DD Form 2367 (Individual Overseas Housing Allowance Report).
fix: PAA 03-20 amplifies 015/20 and does not cancel it.

claim: OHA reimburses actual rent up to the published ceiling, supported by a lease
quote: The maximum amount of monthly rent that is considered in computing the amount of OHA payable is contained in the Joint Travel Regulations

claim: Verify the current edition before completing blocks by number
fix: The current edition is JAN 2024, updated 20250527. State it in the page.
